Text.Text: Unbreakable Beast. You took everything that preserve had and you're still standing. Nothing left in there worth testing you against. Go hold something worth holding.
This one. Rancor, north pens, three years back. Near took my arm. I kept the arm. You haven't taken anything yet worth naming. Come back when you have.

The Tarn Jungle Preserve's gone bad. Pit-breeders bought in, toughened young plated burrowers with beatings instead of trust, called it training, then ran when the beasts broke loose. The beasts stayed. I warded those pens once. Go in, on Dathomir. Put down six of the Young Plated Burrowers, the ones in the pens nearest the gate. Any Young Plated Burrower will do, the breeders beat them all the same. But it only counts if your beast was standing guard for you when it fell: your beast intercepting for you, or holding Guarding Roar, while your party puts them down. Bring back the Unbreakable Beast Tarn Hunt Tally the breeders kept score on. It's in their pen.

Key's yours. Out the east side of this base to the Jungle Landing, then the trail off the landing's north-west side into the Tarnished Jungles. Gate's in the north-east part, by a sealed passage. Go in. Take what's coming. Come back standing.

Beat a beast enough, it stops flinching. Looks like toughness. It's just damage with nowhere left to feel. Real endurance holds because it chose to hold, not because it's too broken to notice pain anymore. Different thing entirely.
Only honest test there is. Not how hard you hit. How much you take and still stand up after. Anyone can swing once. Standing through the swing that should've dropped you, that's the whole discipline.
Every beating the breeders handed out got scratched onto that tally. Proof, plain as anything, of how they ran those pens. Bring it back whole and it stops being their scoreboard.
Six Young Plated Burrowers still out there, your beast guarding you through every fight. Tally's still in their pen.
You're upright. That's the whole test, passed. Let's see it.
Marked, every hit. That's evidence I can use. There's more standing between you and the rest of this preserve, if you've got the stomach.

Five Pen-Scarred Plated Burrowers past the young ones, deeper in. The breeders moved on from beatings to something quieter, a scent dosed into the pens on purpose to keep them in constant pain. That's not toughening. That's cruelty with a schedule. Put the five down while your beast intercepts for you or holds Guarding Roar; any Pen-Scarred Plated Burrower counts while that guard is fresh. Bring me the Unbreakable Beast Beast-Pen Scent Vial from their pen.
Same gate. Deeper pens this time. Watch your footing.

Dosed to keep pain constant, low enough the beast can't rest, high enough it never toughens right. Bring that vial back whole and I've got proof of exactly what they've been dosing my animals with. Proof holds up better than my word alone.

Beatings leave marks people ask questions about. A scent in the pens leaves none. Same cruelty, harder to prove, which is exactly why the breeders switched. Doesn't make it toughening. Makes it worse, honestly, because at least a beating ends.

No. Pain that never lets up isn't a test, it's just damage on a drip. My beasts endure because they trust the hand holding the line, not because the line never stops hurting. That trust is the whole difference between unbreakable and just broken slowly.
Five Pen-Scarred Plated Burrowers, still guarding that vial. Bring it back.
You look like you breathed some of it yourself. Hand it over.
That vial's proof enough on its own. Those breeders just made my case for me, wherever they ran to. Good work. Rest up.

Breeder's Shyrack holds the deep pens. A shyrack the breeders raised in the dark and beat for years until nothing got through his hide clean. Blades skid off him instead of biting. One blade against that just wears its edge down for nothing. Bring two friends who can take a hit themselves, not just deal one. Take him down. Bring me the Unbreakable Beast Clawed Alpha Totem off his harness.
Same gate. Bring people who can stand there and keep standing, not just people who hit hard once.

Took beatings for years, past any sense of it. Somewhere in there he stopped choosing to endure and started just being unable to feel it anymore. That's the difference between him and me, and it's the whole reason he's dangerous now.

Alpha totem marks the toughest bloodline in the pens, the one every other animal learns to hold from. The breeders clawed it apart and hung it on him, a beast that survives beatings instead of one that endures honestly. Bring it back whole and the real line's proven again.

Because one blade tires before his hide does. Simple as that. Bring friends who can take a hit and keep standing, and he's got three fights instead of one easy one, and none of you tire out at the same time he does. That's the whole trick to a hide like his. Outlast it in numbers, since you can't outlast it alone.
Breeder's Shyrack's hide is still holding. Bring friends who can take a hit.
Everybody still standing? Good sign. Let's see the totem.
Whole. That's the real bloodline proven again, finally. Not bad, for people who could take a hit. Rest up. The ones he was beaten beside are next.

Four of them hold the deepest pens now, the Elder Plated Burrowers. Oldest burrowers in the preserve, beaten longest, the ones that stopped feeling anything at all. Bring your people back. Four of them hitting at once is its own kind of endurance test. Take them down while your beast intercepts for you or holds Guarding Roar; any Elder Plated Burrower counts while that guard is fresh. Bring me the Unbreakable Beast Preserve Keeper's Token from their den.
Same gate. Deepest part of the preserve. Stand together. Four of them hitting from four sides tests whether your people can hold a line as much as it tests you.

Taught them to stop feeling it. That was the breeders' whole doctrine: pain isn't something you endure, it's something you stop noticing. Difference between that and real endurance is everything. One's a choice you keep making. The other's just numbness with good posture.

That token's proof of who's allowed to run the pens, sign off on transfers, all of it. The breeders took it when they ran and lost it down there when the burrowers turned. One real token, and every signature they made gets thrown out with it.

Beast holds for the master. Master holds for the beast. Neither one's numb to the other, and neither one stops choosing it, hit after hit. That's the whole bond, shared both directions. Not one thing enduring alone. Two things enduring together.
Four of them still holding the deep pens. Bring the token back.
Your people still standing beside you. Good. Let's see the token.
Whole. Deep pens can be run honest again. One left down there, Old Shyrack, the one Breeder's Shyrack was bred from. You're ready for that.

Last one. Old Shyrack is the sire of Breeder's Shyrack, the oldest shyrack in the preserve. His hide doesn't just stop feeling it. It doesn't break, period. The breeders built that out of the same endurance I've spent my life teaching, and pointed it at anything that comes near. Bring your people. All of them. His hide answers to a lot of hits landing together or it doesn't answer at all. No token this time. Him going down, and staying down, is the whole proof.
Then go. All your people, together. His hide's felt one hit at a time for years and shrugged it off. Give it a lot of hits, all at once, for once.

Breeder's Shyrack stopped feeling it. Old Shyrack stopped needing to feel it in the first place. That's further along the same road, and it's exactly what I've spent my whole life teaching, done right, for the wrong reasons. You've been building the true version this whole time. He's the corrupted end of the same road.

Because one hit, however hard, is still one hit, and his hide's outlasted worse alone. A dozen hits, all at once, from every side, and there's no single point for that endurance to brace against anymore. That's the whole math of taking down something built not to break.

It means what it always meant. Beast holds for master, master holds for beast, both of you choosing it every single hit, never numb to each other even when you're numb to everything else. That's what he lost somewhere in all this. Don't lose it yourself.
His hide's still standing. Bring everyone you've got.
Preserve's gone quiet. Even the pens have stopped fighting the fences. Tell me he's down.

Then he's down, and staying down, which is the whole proof right there. You took everything that preserve had to give and you're still standing, same as I've always measured it. That's the unbreakable bond, both ways, held all the way through. Go hold something worth holding.
Back to standing.
I'll take the six down and bring your tally.
What do you mean, toughen with beatings?
What does endurance actually test?
What's this tally worth?
Not yet.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Tarn Hunt Tally.
Back to standing.
I'll take the five down and bring the vial.
What's in that vial exactly?
Why move from beatings to a scent?
Can a beast under that pain still endure honestly?
Give me a day.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Beast-Pen Scent Vial.
Back to standing.
I'll bring friends who can take a hit too.
How'd his hide get like that?
What does the alpha totem prove?
Why do blades bounce off him specifically?
Haven't got the right friends yet.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Clawed Alpha Totem, whole.
Back to standing.
We'll take the four together and hold.
What did the breeders do to those four?
What's this keeper's token prove?
What does an unbreakable bond actually share?
My people need to rest first.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Preserve Keeper's Token, whole.
Back to standing.
All of us, together, against him.
How's his endurance different from Breeder's Shyrack's?
Why does it take all of us to break one hide?
What does an unbreakable bond mean, once he's gone?
Not till everyone's ready.
He's down. Staying down.
